description: This PHP source file generates a web page for displaying detailed network connection and modem information within a router or gateway management interface. It includes hardware details, IP configurations (IPv4 and IPv6), DHCP parameters, modem status, and diagnostic data, along with embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI adjustments.
